translationRepairs: Structures outside the Xueping Gate in Chang’an fell in without apparent cause.
Structures outside the Xuanping Gate in Chang’an fell in without apparent cause.
宣平 is Xuanping. Xueping is a straightforward place-name mistranscription.
On bingzi Zhao Qian, former general-in-chief, became minister of education.
On bingzi Zhao Qian, the Former General, became minister of education.
前將軍 is the Former General office, distinct from 大將軍, general-in-chief.
That year Liu Yao met Sun Ce at Qu’e and lost; Sun Ce then took control of Wu east of the river.
That year Inspector of Yang Liu Yao fought Yuan Shu’s general Sun Ce at Qu’e; Yao’s army was routed, and Sun Ce then occupied the lands east of the Yangzi.
The existing translation omits Yuan Shu's command relationship and distorts 江東. The proposal restores 袁術將 and accurately renders the region east of the Yangzi.
In the sixth month, on yimao, the emperor visited Wenxi.
In the sixth month, on yiwei, the emperor visited Wenxi.
乙未 is yiwei; yimao would require 乙卯.
On gengwu Li Jue and Guo Si overtook the imperial column at Eastern Ford, shattered the escort, and slew Deng Quan, Shisun Rui, Xuan Bo, Miao Si, Wei Jie, Zhu Zhan, and Ju Jun.
On gengwu Li Jue and Guo Si overtook the imperial column at Eastern Stream, shattered the escort, and slew Deng Quan, Shisun Rui, Xuan Bo, Miao Si, Wei Jie, Zhu Zhan, and Ju Jun.
澗 denotes a stream or ravine, not a ford. Eastern Stream is the accurate reading of 東澗 here.
In the spring of the second year at Xu Yuan Shu declared himself emperor.
In the spring of the second year Yuan Shu declared himself emperor.
The Chinese moves directly from the season and year to Yuan Shu's declaration. The words 'at Xu' are unsupported and fuse awkwardly into his name.
Yet here was a man who bore that burden on his back while being driven onward—was this not fate run to its bitter end!
Yet here was a man who bore that burden on his back and hurried onward—was this not fate run to its bitter end!
趨 is active: the man bears the dynastic burden and hurries onward. The revision keeps the existing idiomatic force while removing the unsupported implication that another agent drove him.
